summary.text: Treg Taylor is a Republican lawyer who served as Alaska attorney general under Gov. Mike Dunleavy from 2021 until August 2025.

According to his campaign, the Department of Law participated in more than 80 legal challenges involving federal actions during his tenure. His campaign emphasizes expanding resource development and working across party lines.

paragraphs.text: Taylor attended the U.S. Air Force Academy before earning a B.A. in political science from Brigham Young University in 2001 and a J.D. from BYU in 2004.

He worked in commercial litigation and as counsel for McKinley Capital Management and ASRC Energy Services before joining the Alaska Department of Law in 2018 as deputy attorney general over the Civil Division.
Taylor served as Alaska attorney general from 2021 until August 2025; he was acting attorney general from January 30 to May 11, 2021, and chaired the bipartisan Attorney General Alliance.
According to his campaign website, he and his wife, Jodi, have raised their six children in Anchorage.

sources.title: Republican Treg Taylor leans on experience as attorney general in gubernatorial pitch
